operations.description: Returns all details of a single order, including last status, items shipped or not.
operations.summary: Returns all details of a order
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] order [PARAMS] authorization id order [SCHEMA] address courier customer freight gift invoice item order phone promotion reference seller shippment wrap

operations.description: Retuns a list of orders associated with this seller. The list is ordered by dateCreated.
operations.summary: Returns orders details
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] orders [PARAMS] authorization limit offset [SCHEMA] address customer freight item metadata order orders seller shippment

operations.description: Returns list of shipments. By default this will return list of the last shipments ordered by dateCreated, folowed by last update date.
operations.summary: Returns list of shipments
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] orders shipments delivered [PARAMS] authorization limit offset status [SCHEMA] item metadata order orders reference shipments shippment status

operations.description: Returns a list of shipments shipped. By Default returns items ordered by dateCreated folowed by last update
operations.summary: Returns a list of shipments shipped
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] orders shipments shipped [PARAMS] authorization limit offset status [SCHEMA] item metadata order orders reference shipments shippment status

operations.description: Returns a list of approved orders. Orders in the `approved` state must be fullfiled imediadetelly.
operations.summary: Return list of approved orders
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] orders status approved [PARAMS] authorization limit offset [SCHEMA] address customer freight item metadata order orders seller shippment

operations.description: Returns a list with canceled orders. Canceled orders should not be fullfiled.
operations.summary: Returns lists of canceled orders
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] orders status canceled [PARAMS] authorization limit offset [SCHEMA] address customer freight item metadata order orders seller shippment

operations.description: Returns a list of orders successfully delivered associated with this seller.
operations.summary: Returns a list of orders successfully delivered associated with this seller.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] orders status delivered [PARAMS] authorization limit offset [SCHEMA] address customer freight item metadata order orders seller shippment

operations.description: Returns a list of orders flagged as new. New orders should not be fullfiled until marketplace flags them as approved.
operations.summary: Returns a list of orders flagged as new.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] orders status new [PARAMS] authorization limit offset [SCHEMA] address customer freight item metadata order orders seller shippment

operations.description: Returns a list of partially deliverd orders. This is a list of orders with items shipped but with not all items ackwlodged as deliverd
operations.summary: Returns a list of partially deliverd orders
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] orders status partially delivered [PARAMS] authorization limit offset [SCHEMA] address customer freight item metadata order orders seller shippment

operations.description: Returns a list of orders that contain one (or more) items that where not shipped. This will list the entire order as well the items with peding shipment. Use this service to track orders that need to be fullfiled.
operations.summary: Returns a list of orders partially fullfiled
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] orders status partially sent [PARAMS] authorization limit offset [SCHEMA] address customer freight item metadata order orders seller shippment

operations.description: Returns a list with orders completely fullfiled, this means orders with all items sent. Orders will ordered by dateCreated fowllowed by last update
operations.summary: Returns a list with orders fully sent
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] orders status sent [PARAMS] authorization limit offset [SCHEMA] address customer freight item metadata order orders seller shippment

operations.description: Returns detailed information of a single product with the seller `skuSellerId`. This service will return a json document with product detail, status, price, invetory among other infomarion availble in the Brand Lovers marketplace
operations.summary: Returns details of a single product using the seller `skuSellerId`
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] product [PARAMS] authorization id seller sku [SCHEMA] attribute dimensions gift price product wrap

operations.description: Get a list of my products loaded into the Marketplace. This dosen't means that products are eligible for sale, just that they are loaded in the database.
operations.summary: Returns a list of products loaded into BrandLovers Marketplace
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] products [PARAMS] authorization limit offset [SCHEMA] attribute dimensions gift metadata price product products response wrap

operations.description: Returns a list with seller products status. Please note that this endpoint will not return all details of each product, just the skuSellerId and status. Also please note that this endpoint will return 250 products per call. For full details of a given procuct use GET /product/{skuSellerId}
operations.summary: Returns seller products status in the marketplace
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] products status [PARAMS] authorization limit offset [SCHEMA] metadata price product products seller status

operations.description: Returns products that are successfully listed for sale.
operations.summary: Returns products that are successfully listed for sale.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] products status selling [PARAMS] authorization limit offset [SCHEMA] attribute controlled dimensions gift image item metadata price product products reference seller selling site status stock wrap

operations.description: Returns trouble ticket history with all messages exchanged. Only tickets related to your seller will be returned. Attempt to read other tickets will return 403 (acess denied).
operations.summary: Get trouble ticket messages
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] ticket messages [PARAMS] authorization id limit offset ticket [SCHEMA] message messages metadata ticket

operations.description: Allows seller to receive and status, queries, requests and complaints from customers. As well related messages
operations.summary: Get customers trouble tickets
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] tickets [PARAMS] authorization limit offset status [SCHEMA] customer metadata reference ticket tickets

operations.description: Confirm shipment canceletion (when requested by the customer) or failure to deliver one shipment
operations.summary: Confirm shipment canceletion (when requested by the customer) or failure to deliver
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] order shipment cancel [PARAMS] authorization id order [SCHEMA] courier item new order reference refund tracking

operations.description: Confirms that a shipment was delivered. Must inform quantity of successfully deliverd items even if items deliverd was less than the original order
operations.summary: Confirms that a shipment was delivered
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] order shipment delivered [PARAMS] authorization id order [SCHEMA] courier invoice newshipmentstatus

operations.description: This enpoint to confirm item exchange when failure to deliver or requested by the customer. All customer requests are tracket via trouble tickets
operations.summary: Confirm item exchange
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] order shipment exchange [PARAMS] authorization id order [SCHEMA] courier item new order reference refund tracking

operations.description: Use this endpoint to return and refund items froma a order. In order to fully return an order list all items and applicate quantity.
operations.summary: Confirm order item return and refund
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] order shipment return [PARAMS] authorization id order [SCHEMA] courier item new order reference refund tracking

operations.description: Updates order to include shipment shiped information. This endpoint can be used to include a single or multiple shipments for any give order. In order to inform that all items of a order where shipped list all of them, including applicable quantities in the payload.
operations.summary: Update new order to include shipment information
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] order shipment sent [PARAMS] authorization id order [SCHEMA] courier invoice newshipmentstatus

operations.description: Bulk update of order shipments status. This alows to inform multiple shipments status
operations.summary: Bulk update of order shipments
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] orders shipments delivered [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] courier invoice item order orders reference shipments shippment

operations.description: Allows bulk updates of orders shippments.
operations.summary: Bulk update of order shipments
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] orders shipments shipped [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] courier invoice item order orders reference shipments shippment

operations.description: Use this enpoint to create a single new product to the Marketplace. This enpoint expects a json document with one product. If you whant to upload multiple products in a single API call use POST /products method. The server will load each product as an individual item that can be manipulated using your own `skuSellerId`. This system is idenpontent, this means that once a `skuSellerId` is created it cannot be re-created using this tool. In order to update, edit a product use the PUT method with the correct reference to your `skuSellerId`
operations.summary: Create a new product to the marketplace
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] product [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] attribute dimensions gift price product wrap

operations.description: This enpoint to creates new products in the Marketplace using `skuSellerId` as a primary key. This enpoint expects a json document with array of products. The server will load each product as an individual item that can be manipulated using your own `skuSellerId`. All requests to This endpoint are idenpontent with respect of the `skuSellerId`, this means that once a `skuSellerId` is created it cannot be re-created using this tool. In order to update use the PUT method with the correct `skuSellerId`. You can also use the POST /product to create a single product per request
operations.summary: Allows new products from the seller to be loaded into the marketplace
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] products [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] attribute dimensions gift price product wrap

operations.description: Use this service to create a new trouble ticket. Use this to include relevant information about the order, comunicate with the customer or marketplace team. Whenever possible message will be pushed to Mobile first. This is the primary mean of comunicaiton with the customer regarding orders, shippments, shippments status. New tickets will be automatically be set to 'OPEN'. Trouble tickets need to be associated with a orderId or customer. New tickets can optionally include a new message.
operations.summary: Creates a new trouble ticket
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] ticket [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] customer message new reference ticket

operations.description: Add a new message to this trouble ticket. Messages can be `CUSTOMER` (customer will be able to see it) or `INTERNAL`.
operations.summary: Add new message to trouble ticket
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] ticket message [PARAMS] authorization id ticket [SCHEMA] message new ticket

operations.description: Update a single product information such as name, brand, attribute, dimension, etc. Please note that data from your request will be merged with existing data. This allows you to easliy update only certain fields without the need to re-inform the other unchanged fields. For example in order to update just the field `title` simply send just this field with new information, remaining fields will not be changed. In order to erase an item the field must be informed as its default value, for example in order to erase the `videos` field must be sent as videos:[]. The `skuSellerId` field is always mandatory in the path and in the product json Object.
operations.summary: Update product details
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] product [PARAMS] authorization id seller sku [SCHEMA] attribute dimensions gift price product update wrap

operations.description: Allows seller to set the SKU prices (MSRP and/or offer price). All prices must be informed in cents. No commas or periods are accepeted. For example one dollar should be informed as 100. Same as $1,2345.67 must be informed solely as 1234567
operations.summary: Allows seller to update prices of a single SKU
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] product prices [PARAMS] authorization id seller sku [SCHEMA] price product

operations.description: Update product status in the Marketplace. Set to `true` to enable, `false` to disable sale.
operations.summary: Enable/disable a single product in the Marketplace
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] product status [PARAMS] authorization id seller sku [SCHEMA] item seller status

operations.description: Update a single product inventory information. Products with zero stock will not be eligible for sale.
operations.summary: Update a single product stock
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] product stock [PARAMS] authorization id seller sku [SCHEMA] stock

operations.description: Allows bulk update of product prices. This endpoint expects a json document with an array of products with the `skuSellerId` and the new price. Server will process each new product update individually and will ackwlodge as much updates as possible, even if a single product update fails. After this request you can query product final status with GET /product/status
operations.summary: Allows bulk update of product prices.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] products prices [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] item price prices product seller

operations.description: Bulk enable/disable products in the marketplace. This endpoint requires an array of objects with the seller SKU `skuSellerId` and boolean value that defines if the product is enabled or not for sale. This endpoint can be used to set a single product or many products.
operations.summary: Bulk enable/disable products in the marketplace
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] products status [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] product status update

operations.description: Bulk product stock update. This endpoint expect a array of products `skuSellerId` with new inventory data
operations.summary: Bulk product stock update
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] products stocks [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] product stock

operations.description: Alows the seller to update the status of a trouble ticket
operations.summary: Update trouble ticket status
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] ticket status [PARAMS] authorization id ticket [SCHEMA] status ticket
